_comment: The research validator's rules (tools/research_validate.py), ported from the workbook's one-sentence definitions. validate.py does not exist (D17), so this port is the REFERENCE and each 'reading' below IS the specification: where a definition was ambiguous, the reading says what was decided and why. The validator runs over the SHIPPED JSON (research.json, bureau.json, vendor.json), the same files the game reads, so the C# side computes over identical input. Codes are never renumbered or reused; a new rule takes the next free number.

codes.definition: Every token parses under the grammar and resolves (IDs, design names, registries, licence and bureau targets, variant parents).
codes.reading: Parsing is the converter's job (G1xx). Here, every shipped atom must resolve to something of the RIGHT kind: technology and doctrine atoms to a project of that kind, design atoms and variant_of to a design project, flag/fielded/focus/xp to their registry, bureau and seized to a bureau, licence and import to a bureau or a vendor, captured to a nation that has a start state, producers to bureaus, exclusive_with to doctrines, restriction lifted_by to a flag. Atoms in every atom-bearing field are checked: prerequisites, cost_reducers, acquisition and doctrine_role.

codes.definition: Design names unique and token-safe; bureaus unique per nation.
codes.reading: Token-safe means that the string design:<name> parses as exactly ONE design atom whose value is the name, byte for byte. That is precisely what lets a modder write the name in the grammar. Design names are unique across all nations, and bureau names are unique within a nation.

codes.definition: No cycles across techs, doctrines, design: edges and variant lineage.
codes.reading: The graph has an edge from a project to EVERY technology, doctrine or design atom in its prerequisites (every alternative of every clause, so a cycle through any alternative counts), and from a variant to its parent. Cost reducers are not gates and are excluded. Each cycle is reported once, by its members.

codes.definition: Nothing requires an item with a later historical year (an OR-clause passes if any alternative is early enough).
codes.reading: For each project and each prerequisite clause, at least one alternative must be no later than the project. A 'base' year is earlier than every dated year. An alternative that is not a project (flag, xp, fielded, focus, licence, bureau) has no year and always passes. Cost reducers and variant lineage are not requirements, so they are excluded.

codes.definition: Every design has a design bureau: a Lead bureau of its own nation or a valid acquisition; producers are in the nation's roster.
codes.reading: A design's acquisition is non-empty. Every bare bureau atom in it, which covers joint and competing bids alike, is a Lead bureau of the design's own nation. Every producer is a bureau of the design's own nation, in any role. The roster cut (active) is NOT part of R5: it is a flag, and every row stays valid.

codes.definition: COND tag present exactly when a design uses an off-map vendor.
codes.reading: A design uses a vendor when any atom in its acquisition, prerequisites or cost_reducers has a vendor id as its value. COND is present if and only if it does.
If doctrine A lists B in exclusive_with, then B lists A. A doctrine never lists itself.

codes.definition: Every start-state holding has its ID prerequisites held.
codes.reading: For every technology or doctrine a nation holds at the start, each prerequisite clause that contains at least one technology or doctrine atom has at least one of those atoms held by the same nation. Alternatives of other kinds are ignored, because 'ID prerequisites' names only ids. Clauses with no id atom are not checked.

codes.definition: Variant lineage stays within one nation.
codes.reading: A design with variant_of has a parent of the same nation.

codes.definition: No category is derived from an ID prefix (AD-M37 section 4).
codes.reading: Over shipped data, two checks. (a) Every technology's category is a declared category that is not itself folded away, so the fold was applied to the category field and not left to be inferred. (b) The property is EXERCISED: at least one technology's authored id does not begin with its category's authored code, so a reader that derived the category from the id would produce a wrong answer somewhere and could be caught. The authored id is read only to measure (b), and never to decide a category. With no disagreeing row the rule FAILS as vacuous, because AD-M37 requires one to be authored deliberately. The code half of R10 is proven by mutation in each implementation: the converter's M1 and this validator's M16 derive the category from the id and must go red.

codes.definition: Every row in the alpha slice has an encoded effect, not prose.
codes.reading: The slice is (i) every technology or doctrine whose effect is not null and (ii) every design with a generated model (design_model.json), whose effect is that model. (i) An effect is exactly {gate_only: bool, modifiers: [...]}: gate_only true means modifiers is empty, and gate_only false means at least one modifier. A modifier is exactly {target, scope, stat or pool, per_mille}, where target is design_stat (with stat), facility_output or power_supply (with pool), scope is a string, and per_mille is a non-zero integer. (ii) Each slice design has exactly one model. Prose can only enter through a field, so every shipped project must have EXACTLY its kind's keys, and any other key refuses. The verdict carries the slice size, because an empty slice passes vacuously (D32).

codes.definition: Every design in the slice has an active lead of its own nation, or a declared acquisition (D26 ruling 2; V110 and V111 are reserved for R10 and R11).
codes.reading: The slice is design_model.json. Every model there is a design project, its unlock names its own id, its year and year_declared equal its design's (a model's year is HISTORICAL and ranks equipment, so a base design is never stamped with a year, D30), and its design either has an ACTIVE Lead bureau of its own nation as lead, or has no lead and an acquisition made only of seized and captured routes (import and licence are DEFER-BETA, so an import-only or licence-only design is not reachable in alpha, D4). A model's supersedes names a model in the same file, of the same class.
